label: Plan accepted as proposed
criterion: Applies to every run where a task-size gauge was rendered and answered — never to a run that owed no gauge, so an exempt slash-command run cannot count as a miss. ✓ the user let the plan proceed as proposed · ✗ the user altered the scope or approach, or declined. A gate walked away from is excluded from both sides and reported as an abandoned count — silence is no verdict on a plan. A gate no judge could answer is likewise absent rather than guessed. Every gate is judged, including those the user answered by picking an option the gate offered: the judge weighs which option was chosen, because passing those through as acceptance would pin a tenth of the denominator at 100% by construction. The call is made by a model and cached per gate, so it reads intent rather than keywords; it is still a judgment, hence the heuristic tier.
